SUCCESSOR AGENCY SPECIAL MEETING
SUCCESSOR AGENCY SPECIAL MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2019
06:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1468
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: CHAIR HOFBAUER, VICE CHAIR BISHOP, DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 Adopt Resolution No. SA 2019-007, A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City Of Palmdale approving an amendment to Disposition and Development Agreement (A-5911) for Parcels 3005-046-021 and 3005-046-023. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Call for Public Comments
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. SA 2019-007.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 5.1
6. ADJOURNMENT.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Hofbauer called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR HOFBAUER, VICE CHAIR BISHOP, DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
PRESENT:
Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Richard J. Loa.
ABSENT:
Juan Carrillo.
Motion: Excuse the absence of Director Carrillo.
Moved by Austin Bishop,
seconded by Richard J. Loa.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Richard J. Loa.
4.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.

seconded by Austin Bishop.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Richard J. Loa.
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1
Adopt Resolution No. SA 2019-007, A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City Of Palmdale approving an amendment to Disposition and Development Agreement (A-5911) for Parcels 3005-046-021 and 3005-046-023. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Call for Public Comments
Executive Director Purtee provided Council with the background for this item and the reason for the Resolution.
Public Comments: None.
Motion: Adopt Resolution No. SA 2019-007.
Moved by Richard J. Loa,
seconded by Austin Bishop.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Richard J. Loa.
Absent: Juan Carrillo.
6.
ADJOURNMENT.
Chair Hofbauer adjourned the meeting at 6:10 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 1st day of October 2019.
